items.label: U.S. House
items.text: U.S. Representative since January 3, 2021; first sworn in for California's 8th District; currently represents the 23rd District. (sources: Office of Rep. Jay Obernolte (house.gov) https://obernolte.house.gov/media/press-releases/jay-obernolte-officially-sworn-representative-californias-8th-district [search summary, primary]; The Conference Board https://www.conference-board.org/bio/jay-obernolte [search summary, secondary])

items.label: State and local offices
items.text: Member of the California State Assembly, 2014 to 2020; member of the Big Bear Lake City Council, 2010 to 2014, including service as mayor (one source gives 2012 to 2014); first elected to the Big Bear City Airport Board in 2005. (sources: Cook Political Report https://www.cookpolitical.com/house/race/239811 [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jay_Obernolte [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Business
items.text: Founded FarSight Studios, a video game developer and publisher, in 1990. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jay_Obernolte [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
